Xpansiv®, a trailblazer in the energy and environmental commodities market, operates the integrated, open, and neutral market platform designed to accelerate the global energy transition. Seeking a Quality Assurance Engineer to perform testing of systems and applications developed by Xpansiv 
Responsibilities:
Create test plans, including, as necessary – manual testing, automated testing, performance testing, regression testing, etc. 
Formulate and document test cases based on test plans 
Execute test cases: 
If necessary, perform manual testing 
If necessary, code/configure automated tests and execute them 
Work with developers and product managers to review identified defects, provide clarifications, discuss possible solutions, etc.

10+ years of experience in software quality assurance with both manual and automated testing

Functional testing 
End-to-End testing 
Cross-browser testing 
Regression testing 
Security testing 
Performance testing 
Experience in Automated Software Testing using tools such as Rest Assured and Cypress 
Experience in testing microservices and APIs 
Experience in using Soap UI and Postman for testing Web Services 
Experience interacting with business analysts, product managers, and business owners for reviewing and validating test plans, test cases, and test results 
Experience with source version control tools such as Git 
Experience working in agile software development process models 
Skills & Abilities:
Strong communication & interaction with clients, developers, business analysts, and management. 
Proven ability in working individually or as a part of team, problem solving, process improvement activities, analytical skills, etc. 
Exceptional attention to detail and time management 
Be a self-starter and work well independently as well as in a collaborative team environment 
Comfortable interacting with executive team members and cross-department 
Ability to quickly absorb business and technical concepts 
Proven ability to work calmly under tight deadlines or in critical situations 
Demonstrate analytical and problem-solving abilities 
What can you expect throughout the interview process:
Step 1- Shortlisting of resume & Recruiter screening
Step 2- Take-home assessment
Step 3- Technical Interview with the team
Step 4- Key Stakeholder + Final hiring manager interview
